svg.title: Automatic Registration
svg.desc: Oath & Action Civic Line R-05 Automatic Registration, the 24 px pixel fit: drawn pixel by pixel on the 24 px grid with a one-pixel line, every pixel Charcoal or empty, keeping the parts that make its master read (DR-198, DR-205). One color, the black edition only (D2-1132). Use at 24 px on 1x screens; from 2x the master draws instead (DR-179's switch). For approval by name on drawings board C; not in use until Dustin approves it.
